Ryan's Range of Recklessness

The laptop is the big screen. Your phone is the crossbow.

playing on your phone?

Host: open this page on the laptop or TV, start a match, and players scan the QR code to join.

Players: drag an arrow from your quiver to the bow, pull the string back, and aim by pointing your phone at the big screen.

Scoring: targets 5 pts · moving targets 15 pts · shoot a bomb to clear everything near it and take the points. First to 100 pts wins — the range screen tints toward the leader's color as they close in. Hits earn shop credits (points ÷ 2, rounded up).

Solo defense: one archer holds the line alone against an orc horde marching in from the horizon. Orcs 5 pts · giants 15 pts (5 hits — an exploding arrow hits for 3) · skinwalkers 25 pts, and only white bolts from the shop can kill them. If the horde reaches you, it costs health — survive as long as you can.
